sections.text:
In an old, quiet forest, there was a donkey who lived a life full of fear. He was terrified by the smallest animals, and everyone made fun of his stupidity and his annoying voice.

One day, while the donkey was wandering in search of food, he found a real, huge lion's skin left by the hunters after they had skinned the lion to take its meat.

The donkey looked at the skin, and a strange idea flashed into his head; What if he wore this skin and frightened all the animals that were mocking and beating him?
Quickly, the donkey put the lion's skin on his back, and covered his head with the lion's head and his entire body, until only his hooves were visible, which he had hidden among the grass.

The disguised donkey went to walk in the middle of the forest with extraordinary confidence, feeling for the first time in his life strength and greatness.

As soon as the animals saw him from afar, they thought he was a real lion, a hungry predator looking for a victim!
Deer ran terrified, monkeys climbed trees, rabbits hid in their holes, and birds flew in the sky to warn the rest. Chaos spread everywhere in fear of this new lion.

The donkey was so happy that he had never felt it in his life. He made the whole forest tremble at the mere sight of him! He strutted around like a true king of the jungle.

The next day, the donkey decided to visit the nearby village to scare away the farmers and their dogs, which had always bitten and chased him.

The donkey walked wearing a lion's skin towards the fields. When the peasants saw him, they threw their axes and ran away to take shelter in their homes for fear of predation.

The donkey felt great victory and extreme arrogance, and he wanted to express his joy loudly, so he completely forgot that he was disguised as a predatory lion!
The donkey opened his mouth under the lion's mask to emit a terrifying roar, as lions do, to complete the play.

However, instead of a loud, mountain-shaking roar, a very loud and unmistakable braying sound emanated from his throat: “Ee-aaa! Ee-aaa!”

The braying echoed throughout the village and the forest!
The peasants and animals stopped running, and turned to see the source of the strange sound; A lion braying like a donkey!
Everyone immediately realized the ridiculous and shameful truth, and ran back towards the alleged “lion”.

When the peasants approached, they lifted the lion's skin with sticks, and discovered that underneath it was the same cowardly donkey!
They beat him with sticks for his ridiculous trick that frightened them and wasted their time, while the other animals were laughing at him from afar and watching him run away, dragging the tails of disappointment and pain.

The donkey returned to the forest, ashamed and broken, after learning a hard lesson. No matter how much you change your clothes and your external appearance to appear as strong and majestic as a lion, your inner truth and original nature will appear helpless sooner or later, and luxurious clothes will not hide a stupid and empty mind forever.
